text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Having received tea leaves from her club, 
Phalaenopsis invited guests over to host 
a modest tea gathering.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Now, today's gathering is not a rigid 
ceremony. 
Please pay no mind to formal etiquette, 
and enjoy yourselves.

text_block_list.name: Samson Big
text_block_list.text:
Mmm—there is no bitterness at all!? 
It's remarkably mellow!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
—This sweetness, this aroma. 
I think I recognize it.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
It's gyokuro stem tea, right? 
...Karigane from Kyoto, perhaps?

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Oho—as expected of Lady Dober. 
You are quite correct.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, stem tea is wonderful. Its fragrance 
blossoms so well 
that it's lovely to use in a tea incense 
burner too.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
And on top of that—water at a slightly 
lower temperature to draw out the 
sweetness. 
A simple teacup to bring out the green of 
the brew. 
Your hospitality truly touches the heart, 
Phalaeno.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. Hearing you say that makes it an 
honor 
and a privilege to have hosted you.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
...Even so, 
to be so knowledgeable in green tea as 
well as black tea... 
Truly, mastery in one path leads to 
insight in all arts.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
It's just that, you know. Both black and 
green tea 
share the very same roots, after all.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for today. 
It was a wonderful tea.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
If you'd like, I'll host next time. 
I'll make sure to have some fine tea 
leaves ready.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
That would be a delight. 
I shall gladly accept your gracious 
invitation.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
(...An invitation from her. 
Black tea, is it? Well then—)

text_block_list.name: Samson Big
text_block_list.text:
Hm, what's wrong, Phalaeno-chan? 
Did you drink too much green tea and can't 
sleep?

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: Ah, no. I shall be heading to bed shortly.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
—Oh, Trainer. 
I have just brewed some tea. Care for a 
cup?
choice_data_list:
Thanks. Black tea is unusual for you, 
isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Think nothing of it. I merely felt like a 
change of pace.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just then, I happened to glance toward the 
corner of the room 
—and saw a massive mountain of black tea 
tins and leaves.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Fufu—it seems you will be joining me 
in savoring them for quite some time.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
...Hmm. "Black Tea: Past and Present," 
"The Western Way of Tea." 
Perhaps I shall borrow these as well—

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
—From left to right: Assam, Darjeeling, 
Dimbula, Uva. 
And then—Nuwara Eliya, correct?

text_block_list.name: Wild Black Tea Master
text_block_list.text:
Wh-Guh... To think that I, a Tea Master, 
could be bested in a tea duel...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, after ceaseless training in the 
ways of black tea, 
the day of Mejiro Dober's tea gathering 
finally arrived.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
...Keemun, Uva, Tieguanyin. And— 
this Earl Grey carries a truly unique 
character.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
You blended these tea leaves 
yourself, didn't you, Lady Dober? 
It has such a wonderfully soothing aroma.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, thank you. 
I'm impressed you could tell.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
—The measure of the leaves. The steeping. 
The pour— 
Everything is ideal... That's amazing...!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
No, my skill is merely a crash course. 
Though, if I may say just one thing—

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
—Whatever the domain may be, 
I simply refused to fall behind Lady 
Dober. 
I suppose it was that singular resolve 
which brought this about.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...Heh. I see.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
—In that case. By the time we race again, 
I'll make sure I'm ready too.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
So that I can welcome a horse girl like 
you 
with everything I've got... you know?

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: —I am honored. It is just what I desire.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Trainer. 
I have just brewed some tea again.
choice_data_list: Huh? You're having green tea today?

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. Now that things have settled down, 
I found myself longing for a familiar 
taste.

flavor.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Well... something like that, I suppose. 
Though putting it that way sounds a bit 
grandiose.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
In any case, it simply goes to show 
that I am still green.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, thank you. 
...Even though my own heart is ever so 
fierce.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Now then. I shall partake as well, 
and calm my spirits.
